body.statement: For every \(I\in\mathfrak I_{q,k}^{\ge3}\), complete support enumeration of the explicitly H-represented factors \(K_H\), followed by standard exact min-sum and max-sum elimination on the contracted decomposition, computes \(\underline\theta\) and \(\overline\theta\), two rational attaining finite SCMs, and a certificate \(\Gamma\) in \(2^{O(q^2(k+1)^2)}\operatorname{poly}(B)\) bit operations. Under the forgetful embeddings in \(\text{prop:comparator-class-relations}\), this strictly tightens the stationary-point guarantee of Shridharan--Iyengar and the epsilon-sharp computational guarantee of Duarte et al. on the common explicit bounded-width subclass by returning exact rational sharp endpoints and independently replayable attainment records.
body.justification: The theorem is the exact tractability kernel for higher-degree canonical bounds under a representation parameter that genuinely controls every local domain.
body.gap: Shridharan--Iyengar use Frank--Wolfe for three or more intervened C-components, while Duarte et al. provide epsilon-sharp branch-and-bound; neither gives this exact width-sensitive rational guarantee.
body.consumer: The causaloptim graph-to-bound workflow gains a mathematically specified fallback for eligible small higher-degree instances after a future exporter supplies the explicit input and decomposition.
